Another thought: maybe the game is a "mirror/laser" puzzle, and clicking a cell toggles a mirror there. But the click on the empty gray cell (40,25) had no effect...
Wait — maybe the click effect only occurs when clicking a specific color: the blue square. Let me try clicking the blue square at (25,61).

Or, maybe a click only has an effect when the clicked cell is adjacent to something.
Let me try clicking the blue square.
